def compute_model_placement(gpu_num, models):
    """Greedily balance current KVPR, then apply best improving model moves and swaps."""
    placement = {i: [] for i in range(gpu_num)}
    remaining = [GPU_MEM_SIZE] * gpu_num
    load = [0.0] * gpu_num

    for model in sorted(models, key=lambda m: m.req_rate / m.slo, reverse=True):
        gpu = min(
            (i for i in range(gpu_num) if model.model_size <= remaining[i]),
            key=lambda i: load[i] / remaining[i] if remaining[i] else float("inf"),
            default=None,
        )
        if gpu is None:
            raise ValueError(f"Unable to place model of size {model.model_size} GB")
        placement[gpu].append(model)
        load[gpu] += model.req_rate / model.slo
        remaining[gpu] -= model.model_size

    for _ in range(len(models)):
        p = [load[i] / remaining[i] if remaining[i] else float("inf")
             for i in range(gpu_num)]
        best, action = max(p), None

        for a in range(gpu_num):
            for x in placement[a]:
                wx, sx = x.req_rate / x.slo, x.model_size
                for b in range(gpu_num):
                    if a == b or remaining[b] <= sx:
                        continue
                    q = max((load[a] - wx) / (remaining[a] + sx),
                            (load[b] + wx) / (remaining[b] - sx),
                            *(p[i] for i in range(gpu_num) if i != a and i != b))
                    if q < best:
                        best, action = q, ("move", a, b, x)

        for a in range(gpu_num):
            for b in range(a + 1, gpu_num):
                for x in placement[a]:
                    wx, sx = x.req_rate / x.slo, x.model_size
                    for y in placement[b]:
                        wy, sy = y.req_rate / y.slo, y.model_size
                        ra, rb = remaining[a] + sx - sy, remaining[b] + sy - sx
                        if ra <= 0 or rb <= 0:
                            continue
                        q = max((load[a] - wx + wy) / ra,
                                (load[b] - wy + wx) / rb,
                                *(p[i] for i in range(gpu_num) if i != a and i != b))
                        if q < best:
                            best, action = q, ("swap", a, b, x, y)

        if action is None:
            break
        if action[0] == "move":
            _, a, b, x = action
            w, s = x.req_rate / x.slo, x.model_size
            placement[a].remove(x)
            placement[b].append(x)
            load[a], load[b] = load[a] - w, load[b] + w
            remaining[a], remaining[b] = remaining[a] + s, remaining[b] - s
        else:
            _, a, b, x, y = action
            wx, sx = x.req_rate / x.slo, x.model_size
            wy, sy = y.req_rate / y.slo, y.model_size
            placement[a].remove(x)
            placement[b].remove(y)
            placement[a].append(y)
            placement[b].append(x)
            load[a], load[b] = load[a] - wx + wy, load[b] - wy + wx
            remaining[a], remaining[b] = remaining[a] + sx - sy, remaining[b] + sy - sx

    return placement

def compute_model_placement(gpu_num, models):
    """Greedily balance current KVPR, then apply best improving model moves and swaps."""
    placement = {i: [] for i in range(gpu_num)}
    remaining = [GPU_MEM_SIZE] * gpu_num
    load = [0.0] * gpu_num

    for model in sorted(models, key=lambda m: m.req_rate / m.slo, reverse=True):
        gpu = min(
            (i for i in range(gpu_num) if model.model_size <= remaining[i]),
            key=lambda i: load[i] / remaining[i] if remaining[i] else float("inf"),
            default=None,
        )
        if gpu is None:
            raise ValueError(f"Unable to place model of size {model.model_size} GB")
        placement[gpu].append(model)
        load[gpu] += model.req_rate / model.slo
        remaining[gpu] -= model.model_size

    for _ in range(len(models)):
        p = [load[i] / remaining[i] if remaining[i] else float("inf")
             for i in range(gpu_num)]
        best, action = max(p), None

        for a in range(gpu_num):
            for x in placement[a]:
                wx, sx = x.req_rate / x.slo, x.model_size
                for b in range(gpu_num):

                    q = max((load[a] - wx) / (remaining[a] + sx),
                            (load[b] + wx) / (remaining[b] - sx),
